name: B10-0424/2026 – After recital D – Am 81
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: Da. whereas discourse that seeks to problematise the ‘entryism’ of any minority group into European politics is pernicious, as it risks denying that minority group any legitimate means of political participation in their own society; whereas such discourse has a catastrophic historical legacy in European politics and must be condemned;
